stem: A rooting tray appears unusually wet and several cuttings are declining. What is the best technician response?
choices: Add more water because cuttings should never dry
Document the condition, verify the assigned moisture and environmental process, and escalate if outside SOP
Remove all labels so the tray can drain faster
rationale: Technicians should verify conditions and follow the defined rooting process rather than automatically adding water or redesigning the system.
